# Before the owner approves publication

Read the current draft, approved brief, feedback, voice and publishing plan. Check the actual version, not an earlier screenshot.

- Does the article fulfill its promise and match the agreed positioning?
- Are facts, numbers, quotations and examples supported? Are necessary limitations and attribution clear?
- Are links useful and working? Are planned pages incorrectly presented as live?
- Does the actual output have appropriate titles, descriptions, canonicals and robots directives? Use structured data only where appropriate and consistent with visible content.
- Are every image and diagram, including the last figure, readable and complete on desktop and mobile? Check crop, overflow and spacing.
- Is the next reader action useful and real?

Save findings and verification evidence beside the draft. Fix authorized defects and recheck. Keep unavailable checks marked unverified. Ask the owner to approve the reviewed version before Ready to publish. A PR or CMS draft is not a published page; verify the live URL only after authorized publication.
